budget.feasible_packing_explanation: Canonical SKILL.md sources for the three primary skills sum to 39,775 whole-file bytes (38,929 body bytes). The budget scope is APGR-controlled initial bytes, which covers the 7,939 B provider instruction file, the estimated mandatory doctrine slice, and the three complete canonical bodies; provider-native tool-schema and token overhead are accounted separately and remain unavailable. A 55,000 B controlled budget with a 42,000 B skill-body allocation holds all three complete bodies without truncation. Under the originally frozen 25,000 B budget the three bodies cannot fit, so go-test-profile is deferred to turn 2 through late acquisition; that alternative is retained as a deferred plan, not as the calibration expectation.
